config_set_lines: set interfaces ge-0/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-0/0/1 unit 0 family inet address 10.0.2.1/24
set security zones security-zone trust interfaces ge-0/0/0.0
set security zones security-zone untrust interfaces ge-0/0/1.0
set applications application app-ssh protocol tcp
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-deny-ssh match source-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-deny-ssh match destination-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-deny-ssh match application app-ssh
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-deny-ssh then deny
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-allow match source-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-allow match destination-address any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-allow match application any
set security policies from-zone trust to-zone untrust policy p-allow then permit
